# Supertext SDK (bundled copy)

Built JavaScript of the TypeScript part of the [Supertext SDK](https://github.com/Supertext/Supertext-API-SDK-and-Guide) (`sdk/typescript`), version 0.3.0, commit `f7bd4141a1e910fea7443ea74b092091895e3717`. `package.json` only marks the files as ES modules.

Don't edit these files: fix the SDK in its own repository, then run `scripts/vendor-sdk.sh`.
